derivation.method: Authored from the pinned Steel Compendium only (verified pin fb83a789 via git ls-tree). Level-one baselines copied from tests/fixtures/v94-tactician-expected.json (reviewed). No evaluator, content, convex or headless code read or run.
derivation.staminaMaximum: Tactician Basics: 21 at 1st level + 9 per level after 1st; kit Stamina bonus x echelon; levels 1-3 are echelon 1 (rule/general/echelon.md). Field Arsenal overlapping Stamina is the single chosen value (unchanged from level one).
derivation.recoveriesMaximum: Tactician Basics: 10; no level-2/3 feature changes it.
derivation.noNumericSheetChange: EXPLICIT: no level-2 or level-3 Tactician feature (Perk, Infiltration Tactics, Goaded, Melee Superiority, Out of Position), no doctrine ability, no 7-focus ability and none of the selected perks changes any numeric sheet value (recoveries, speed, stability, disengage, characteristics, potency, size). The only numeric changes are Stamina maximum (+9 per level) and the recovery/winded values derived from it. Characteristic Increase first appears at 4th level.
derivation.abilityCounts: Advancement table: level 2 adds one 5-focus doctrine ability (Abilities column stays 3, 5); level 3 adds one 7-focus ability (Abilities 3, 5, 7).
derivation.abilityDamage: "X + R damage" adds the Reason score (rule/dice/ability-roll.md Characteristics and Damage); kit damage bonus added per chapter/kits.md Damage Bonuses and Field Arsenal overlap choice; all witnesses have Reason 2.
derivation.potency: Tactician potency weak R-2 / average R-1 / strong R = 0/1/2 with Reason 2 (class/tactician.md; rule/character/potency.md).

uncertainties.resolution: Grouping taken from en/books/heroes/clean/Draw Steel Heroes.md lines 13012-13106 (Insurgent: Fog of War, Try Me Instead; Mastermind: I've Got Your Back, Targets of Opportunity; Vanguard: No Dying on My Watch, Squad! On Me!). Unified ability front matter "subclass" agrees for all six.

uncertainties.passage: 2nd-Level Doctrine Features Table lists Mastermind "Goaded" without a hyperlink (unified and book).
uncertainties.resolution: feature/tactician/level-2/goaded.md (subclass: mastermind) is the feature; book line 12994 prints it under the table.

uncertainties.passage: hit-em-hard.md: "whenever you or any ally deals damage to a target marked by you, that creature gains 2 surges, which they can use immediately."
uncertainties.resolution: INTERPRETATION: "that creature" = the creature who dealt the damage (you or the ally); surges are a hero benefit and "use immediately" fits the attacker.
alternatives: the marked target gains the surges (grammatically nearest noun, but contrary to intent of a tactician buff)

uncertainties.passage: try-me-instead.md: target "Self", distance "Self; see below", keywords Melee, Strike, Weapon; Effect: "you can make the following weapon strike with a distance of melee 1 against a creature."
uncertainties.resolution: INTERPRETATION: the power roll resolves only the optional embedded strike against one creature at melee 1; kit melee damage bonus applies (ability has Melee and Weapon keywords and deals rolled damage per chapter/kits.md). Kit melee distance bonus would also extend melee 1 but is 0 for every eligible witness.
alternatives: treat target Self literally (no damage target) - rejected, contradicts Effect text

uncertainties.passage: I've Got Your Back tiers: taunted (EoT); Try Me Instead tiers: frightened (save ends) with no named source.
uncertainties.resolution: INTERPRETATION: the source of the taunted / frightened condition is the ability user (the tactician). condition/taunted.md and condition/frightened.md require a source creature.
alternatives: source is the ally who was protected (not supported by text)

uncertainties.passage: no-dying-on-my-watch.md has Ranged, Strike, Weapon keywords but no damage in any tier.
uncertainties.resolution: No kit damage bonus (chapter/kits.md applies damage bonuses to damage-dealing abilities only). Ranged distance bonus would apply to Ranged 5 but both witness kits (Martial Artist, Mountain) have none.

uncertainties.passage: feature/tactician/level-2/perk.md and Heroes book # Perks do not state whether a perk already owned (e.g. Teamwork) may be taken again.
uncertainties.resolution: Not resolved; witnesses avoid Teamwork. Teamwork is listed as eligible by group only.
alternatives: duplicates permitted with no extra benefit

uncertainties.resolution: chapter/kits.md Distance Bonus applies to Ranged AND Weapon abilities; Fog of War stays Ranged 10 even for v94-tactician-1 with Sniper +10.

uncertainties.passage: squad-on-me.md: bonus to stability equal to your Might score until the start of your next turn.
uncertainties.resolution: Temporary combat effect; sheet stability unchanged (v94-tactician-3-alt stays 2).

automaticFeatures.name: Infiltration Tactics
automaticFeatures.summary: You have trained your squad to work together, stay silent, and wait for the opportune time to strike. Whenever you or any ally within 10 squares of you becomes hidden, that creature gains 1 surge.

automaticFeatures.name: Goaded
automaticFeatures.summary: You have learned to leverage your marked foes' psychology and goad them into acting before they're tactically ready. Whenever a creature marked by you uses a strike that targets you or any ally within your line of effect, you can use a free triggered action to change one target of the strike to you or another ally within your line of effect. The new target must be within distance of the ability and within line of effect of the creature using it.

automaticFeatures.name: Melee Superiority
automaticFeatures.summary:
After constant drills, you can more accurately anticipate an enemy's plan and thwart their attempts to move across the battlefield. Whenever you make an opportunity attack, the target's speed is reduced to 0 until the end of the current turn.

**Mark Benefit:** When a creature marked by you attempts to move or shift within distance of your melee free strike, you can use a free triggered action and spend 2 focus to make a melee free strike against that creature.

levelThree.sourceAdvancementTable: en/unified/md/class/tactician.md (row 3rd: Out of Position, 7-Focus Ability; Abilities 3, 5, 7; Doctrine Abilities 5)

automaticFeatures.name: Out of Position
automaticFeatures.summary: Even before battle begins, your enemies struggle to keep up with your tactics. At the start of an encounter, you can use a free triggered action to use your Mark ability against one enemy you have line of effect to, even if you are surprised. You can then slide the marked target up to 3 squares, ignoring stability. The target can't be moved in a way that would harm them (such as over a cliff), leave them dying, or result in them suffering a condition or other negative effect.
